_comment: The commit each dispatched APK was cut from. Updated by hand at dispatch.

lastBuild.note: The maintainer explicitly named Build 12 for one production Android App Bundle candidate. GitHub Actions run 33731736686 was accepted from df205cf58f061cea4a608d6a53a84413f3b8fd7e after the API 36 source gate, Expo Doctor, config resolution, export, and targeted mutation checks. The new manual workflow was observed in progress. It uses the GitHub-local EAS executor, verifies the AAB ZIP and JAR signature, preserves an artifact, and publishes play-candidate-12 only after all gates pass. It deliberately does not submit to Google Play. No AAB, Console upload, public policy URL, screenshot set, installation, or real-device evidence exists yet.
